verification_report.summary: Independent sequential verification found no critical errors or gaps under the explicitly accepted original NUMA construction and stated standard inputs. All six crucial claims pass: the fixed trial density is smooth and positive exactly off the two real hypersurfaces; compact-interval dependence gives a uniform interval of initial perturbations; both endpoint determinant formulas and barrier directions are correct, including q<0 on the right; the traps exclude every finite interior continuation breakdown; every derivative satisfies |h^(j)| <= C_j p delta^(-2j), which proves smooth flat zero extension; and the global potentials have semipositive solution forms, the same fixed measure, and distinct normalized representatives. The unchanged smooth nonclosed Hermitian background retains its accepted bounded-mass property. The audit used no other thin-zero-set audit, numerical evidence, new PDE theorem, or novelty assumption. The complete 52-deduction and 4-reference report is saved as results/numa_thin_zero_set_independent_01/verification_report.md.
